guard: json.stringify refuses what has no canonical form, json.parse refuses a __proto__ key, and sort's order is total. (FAIL-FAST suite: markers are upstream of the cells they guard.)

mutations.name: json.stringify silently canonicalizes again
mutations.expectRed: `json.stringify` refuses a value with no canonical form (L4016), naming the path
mutations.completionMarker: ok `json.stringify` is the canonical form (sorted keys, no spaces)
mutations.cell: `json.stringify` refuses a value with no canonical form (L4016), naming the path
mutations.note: The unchecked call drops undefined members and turns NaN into null — the measured pre-fix information loss.

mutations.name: json.parse mints an own __proto__ field again
mutations.expectRed: `json.parse` refuses a "__proto__" key (L4016), exactly as the literal refuses it
mutations.completionMarker: ok `json.stringify` is the canonical form (sorted keys, no spaces)
mutations.cell: `json.parse` refuses a "__proto__" key (L4016), exactly as the literal refuses it
mutations.note: With the check gone the parse is a bypass around L1028 and L4014, the measured pre-fix hole.

mutations.name: NaN compares equal to every number again, the shipped defect
mutations.expectRed: `sort` is total: NaN after every number, undefined below null, both directions agreeing
mutations.completionMarker: ok `sort` orders numbers by value and strings by code unit
mutations.cell: `sort` is total: NaN after every number, undefined below null, both directions agreeing
mutations.note: Without the NaN arm the comparator answers 0 against every number, and `sort([1, NaN, 0])` returns an unsorted list.

mutations.name: kinds no longer rank, so undefined and null shuffle by arrival order
mutations.replace:
const ra = rankOf(a);
  const rb = rankOf(b);
mutations.expectRed: `sort` is total: NaN after every number, undefined below null, both directions agreeing
mutations.completionMarker: ok `sort` orders numbers by value and strings by code unit
mutations.cell: `sort` is total: NaN after every number, undefined below null, both directions agreeing
mutations.note: Without the rank comparison, undefined falls through to a canonical form that is not a string and compares equal to everything — the measured arrival-order behavior. (The unused rank locals are accepted by tsx; the suite reddens on the cell, not on a compile error.)
